name: Greater Planar Rift
source: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege
description: A ragged planar rift drags things into its depths and hurls creatures through from its terminal end.
disable: Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 46) to seal the rift

generalAbilities.name: Greater Planar Rift
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the rift

Effect The creature must succeed at a DC 44 Will Saving Throw save or be drawn into the rift. A creature so drawn in becomes Stunned 3 and immediately teleports to a different random area in Kharnas's ruins.
